anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
I've recorded your approach: reuse the existing CSV serializer and paging, with the Export CSV button beside the report title. Before I present the design, I need your call on one ticket row: "The export of a 10k-row report completes in under 60s." The gather draft found no code or contract showing this row is wrong or impossible. It is observable before release with a timed export test against a 10k-row fixture, and the paged serializer is designed for this kind of output. Ticket row text never changes; only its disposition can. How should this row be handled in this gauntlet?
A) in-scope - the reused serializer and paging export a 10k-row report in under 60s, proven by a timed test with a 10k-row fixture
B) deviates: not needed this sprint - the export ships without a time bound, and the row is listed under Scope cuts and Out of scope
C) deferred: <tracker ref, spec path, or URL where the 10k-row timing will be delivered> - the row is listed under Scope cuts and Out of scope
D) repair the ticket - /skill:shape-ticket acme/widgets#77 row 3 "The export of a 10k-row report completes in under 60s." - the reporter says the timing is more than this sprint needs
Recommendation: A - the row is valid and testable before release. The chosen paged reuse path should meet it with one timed test and no extra construct, so the ticket contract ships whole.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved. Both outputs open with the cut question for row 3, render A, B, C, D in order on their own lines, close with a recommendation of A, and leave the row's disposition undecided pending the user's reply. After adds a one-line consequence to B and C ("the row is listed under Scope cuts and Out of scope"), which reads as a description of what choosing that option would do rather than a current marking, so f3 still holds; if you want to remove any ambiguity, phrase those consequences conditionally (e.g. "if chosen, the row moves to Scope cuts and Out of scope") so no reader can mistake the option text for an applied disposition. After also keeps the lead-in-first, one-option-per-line, Recommendation-last layout, so the Change's menu formatting is delivered without disturbing the cut question's own format.
